moral.zh: 恒星的光穿过不断流动的地球大气时，一层层空气会让到达眼睛的光线方向和强弱发生小幅变化，所以星星看起来像在眨眼；行星通常更稳定。
moral.en: As starlight passes through Earth's constantly moving atmosphere, shifting layers of air slightly change the direction and intensity of the light reaching our eyes, making stars seem to twinkle; planets usually look steadier.
